column1:
After a fall or slight collision which did not have any consequences for the passengers of the motor-cycle, what should the rider of the motor-cycle do?
1) Carry the motor-cycle to the edge of the road and continue their journey by other means.
2) Take care of themselves and the pillion-passenger and continue their journey, provided that they check the function of their motor-cycle and make sure that they can drive it safely.
3) Visit as a precaution an emergency hospital for medical examinations.
column2:
在发生摔倒或轻微碰撞且乘客没有受到伤害后，摩托车驾驶员应该怎么办？
1) 将摩托车搬到路边，改乘其他交通工具继续行程。
√ 2) 照顾好自己和后座乘客并继续行程，前提是必须检查摩托车的功能并确保可以安全驾驶。
3) 作为预防措施，前往急诊医院进行医疗检查。
column4:
When do the tyres of the motor-cycle have a better performance:
1) When they are cold.
2) After they have been warmed.
3) They always have the same performance.
column5:
摩托车轮胎在什么时候表现更好？
1) 寒冷（刚起步）时。
√ 2) 在跑热（加热）之后。
3) 表现始终相同。
column7:
In the summer should you ride a motor-cycle wearing shorts?
1) No, because with the slightest fall you may suffer serious bodily injuries.
2) Yes, but carefully and at a low speed.
3) Yes, provided that you wear a crash-helmet.
column8:
夏天应该穿着短裤骑摩托车吗？
√ 1) 不应该，因为哪怕是极轻微的摔倒也可能导致严重的人身伤害。
2) 应该，但要小心且低速行驶。
3) 应该，只要佩戴头盔即可。
column10:
If, on the road where you are riding the motor-cycle, there is a part with recent asphalt covering, what should you do?
1) You should avoid it.
2) You should ignore it.
3) You should follow it, because the tyre grip is better there.
column11:
如果你骑摩托车时，路面上有一部分是新铺设的沥青，你应该怎么办？
1) 你应该避开它（新沥青通常带有油性，非常滑）。
2) 你应该无视它。
√  3) 你应该走在上面，因为那里的轮胎抓地力更好。
column13:
Riding your motor-cycle on a crossroads, you have the right of way. Should you claim it persistently?
1) Yes, because this is legal.
2) No, because the accident with a two-wheeled motor-cycle does not have unpleasant consequences for its rider.
3) No, because this is dangerous.
column14:
骑摩托车通过路口时你拥有优先权。你应该执意强行索取优先权吗？
1) 应该，因为这是合法的。
2) 不应该，因为与两轮摩托车发生事故不会给骑手带来不愉快后果。
√ 3) 不应该，因为这样做很危险。
column16:
At an ideal braking, what is the participation percentage of the brake of each wheel of the motor-cycle?
1) 75% the front and 25% the rear.
2) 50% the front and 50% the rear.
3) 25% the front and 75% the rear.
column17:
在理想制动（刹车）时，摩托车每个车轮的制动参与比例是多少？
√ 1) 前轮 75%，后轮 25%。
2) 前轮 50%，后轮 50%。
3) 前轮 25%，后轮 75%。
column19:
Which is the vertical allowance (moving free up and down) that the chain which transfers the motion from the engine to the wheel of the motor-cycle must have, if examined in the middle of the distance between the engine and the wheel?
1) 4-5 cm.
2) 2-3 cm.
3) It must be very tight.
column20:
如果在发动机和车轮之间的中间位置检查，摩托车传动链条的垂直活动间隙（上下自由移动量）应为多少？
1) 4-5 厘米。
√ 2) 2-3 厘米。
3) 必须非常紧。
column22:
A two-wheeled motor-cycle with an engine of 75 cc is moving in a provincial road network. What is the maximum permissible speed limit at which it can move?
1) 70 km/h.
2) 80 km/h.
3) 100 km/h.
column23:
一辆发动机排量为 75 cc 的两轮摩托车在省道（国道）网上行驶。它允许移动的最高限速是多少？
√  1) 70 公里/小时。
2) 80 公里/小时。
3) 100 公里/小时。

column1:
You are going to turn right immediately. Which should be your last action before turning?
1) Give the correct signal.
2) Cast a quick glance over your right shoulder.
3) Select the correct gear.
4) Take up the correct position for turning.
column2:
你打算立即右转。转弯前的最后一个动作应该是：
1) 给出正确的信号（打灯）。
√ 2) 向右肩后方快速扫视一眼（检查盲区）。
3) 选择正确的档位。
4) 占据正确的转弯位置。
column4:
Why should a motor-cyclist even in the day-time ride having their lights on?
1) So as to be better visible.
2) So as to be able to see better the vehicles coming from the opposite direction.
3) So as to be able to see better the vehicles he/she follows.
column5:
为什么摩托车手即使在白天也应开启车灯行驶？
√ 1) 为了更容易被其他人看见。
2) 为了能更好地看清对向来车。
3) 为了能更好地看清前车。
column7:
What should a motor-cyclist be careful about before buying a crash-helmet?
1) The helmet must be coloured.
2) The helmet must be of an approved type and fit the head of the motor-cyclist who is going to use it.
3) The helmet must be available in the market irrespective of whether it is of an approved type or not.
column8:
摩托车手在购买头盔前应注意什么？
1) 头盔必须是有颜色的。
√ 2) 头盔必须是经批准的类型，且适合该摩托车手的头型。
3) 头盔只要市场上能买到就行，无论是否经过批准。
column10:
Suddenly, whilst riding your motor-cycle, a ball appears on the road. What should you do?
1) You should maintain a steady course.
2) You should try to avoid the ball.
3) You should brake, because a child may follow it.
column11:
当你骑行时，路面上突然出现一个球，你应该怎么办？
1) 保持原路线行驶。
2) 尝试躲避那个球。
√ 3) 你应该刹车，因为可能会有孩子跟着球跑出来。
column13:
Riding your motor-cycle you are approaching a crossroad where the traffic light is red. There is a pedestrian crossing ahead. Where should you stop in order to wait until the light becomes green?
1) On the pedestrian crossing.
2) Just after the pedestrian crossing.
3) Just before the pedestrian crossing.
column14:
骑摩托车接近红灯路口，前方有人行横道。你应该停在哪里等待绿灯？
1) 停在人行横道线上。
2) 刚好穿过人行横道后的位置。
√ 3) 紧贴人行横道线之前的位置。
column16:
Riding your motor-cycle you are behind a lorry. What should you do?
1) You should overtake it or keep well behind it, so that you have a good visibility.
2) You should overtake it, so that you have anyhow a good visibility.
3) You should follow just behind it.
column17:
骑摩托车行驶在货车后面，你应该怎么办？
√ 1) 你应该超越它，或者保持较远的距离，以便拥有良好的视野。
2) 你应该超越它，以便无论如何都能有好的视野。
3) 你应该紧跟在它后面。
column19:
Which type of oil should you use in the engine of your motor-cycle and how often should you replace the oils?
1) The type determined by the manufacturer and replace the oils when you notice that the engine gets overheated.
2) The type determined by the manufacturer and replace the oils every 1000 m.
3) The type which has the fluidity determined by the manufacturer and replace the oils regularly according to those determined by the manufacturers of the oils and the motor-cycle.
column20:
摩托车发动机应使用哪种机油，以及多久更换一次？
1) 使用制造商规定的类型，并在发现发动机过热时更换。
2) 使用制造商规定的类型，并每 1,000 米更换一次。
√ 3) 使用具有制造商规定流动性（粘度）的机油，并根据机油和摩托车制造商规定的周期定期更换。
column22:
When it is raining and you are riding a motor-cycle, at what distance should you follow a leading vehicle?
1) At a distance you consider as safe.
2) About twice that when the road is dry.
3) At the same distance you keep when the road is dry.
column23:
下雨骑摩托车时，你应该以多大距离跟随前车？
1) 你认为安全的任何距离。
√ 2) 大约是干燥路面时距离的两倍。
3) 与干燥路面时保持相同的距离。

column1:
In a very hot weather, the pitch on the road surface may soften. Which parts of the motor-cycle are affected more?
1) Suspensions.
2) Tyre grip on the road.
3) Exhaust pipe.
column2:
在非常炎热的天气下，路面的沥青可能会变软。摩托车的哪些部分受影响最大？
1) 悬挂系统。
√ 2) 轮胎在路上的抓地力。
3) 排气管。
column4:
Which type of igniter (sparking plug) should you use in your motor-cycle?
1) The type recommended by your friend motor-cyclist.
2) Any type, provided it has been screwed properly.
3) The same or an equivalent type to that determined by the manufacturer.
column5:
摩托车应该使用哪种类型的火花塞（Igniter/Sparking plug）？
1) 车友推荐的类型。
2) 任何类型，只要拧紧了就行。
√ 3) 制造商指定的或同等规格的类型。
column7:
How tight should the helmet on the motor-cyclist’s head be?
1) Very tight, so that it does not come off in case of a collision.
2) It should fit without squeezing the head.
3) It should be very loose so that the head does not sweat.
column8:
头盔戴在摩托车手头上应该多紧？
1) 非常紧，以免在碰撞时脱落。
√ 2) 应该贴合头部但不会产生挤压感。
3) 应该非常松，以免头部出汗。
column10:
Suddenly, whilst riding your motor-cycle, you meet a big oil stain on the road. What should you do?
1) You should try to avoid it in every possible way.
2) You should pass the point with the accelerator off holding the handlebars steadily in a straight line.
3) You should speed up and pass the stain quickly.
column11:
当你骑行时，突然遇到路面上有一大片油渍，你应该怎么办？
1) 尝试用一切可能的方法躲避它。
√ 2) 松开油门，保持车把稳定并直线通过该点（避免在油渍上转向或制动）。
3) 加速并快速通过油渍。
column13:
The rider should, when riding?
1) Hold the handlebars with both hands, unless they give an arm signal in accordance with the provisions of the Highway Code.
2) Hold the handlebars with the right hand.
3) Hold the handlebars with the left hand.
column14:
骑行时，骑手应该：
√ 1) 用双手握住车把，除非根据交通规则做出手臂信号。
2) 只用右手握住车把。
3) 只用左手握住车把。
column16:
What happens to the horsepower of your motor-cycle, when increasing the revolutions of the motor-cycle engine you pass the red area of your rev-counter?
1) It is reduced.
2) It is increased.
3) It remains steady.
column17:
当增加发动机转速并超过转速表的红色区域（红线区）时，摩托车的马力会发生什么变化？
√ 1) 马力会减小。
2) 马力会增加。
3) 马力保持稳定。
column19:
The check of the tolerance of the engine valves of the motor-cycle is carried out by:
1) The rider of the motor-cycle.
2) Anyone who can ride a motor-cycle.
3) Only a garage that operates legally.
column20:
摩托车发动机气门间隙的检查应由谁进行？
1) 摩托车驾驶员。
2) 任何会骑摩托车的人。
√ 3) 仅限合法经营的修理厂（Garage）。
column22:
A two-wheeled motor-cycle with an engine of 200 cc is moving on a provincial road network. Which is the maximum permissible speed limit at which it can move?
1) 70 km/h.
2) 90 km/h
3) 100 km/h.
column23:
一辆发动机排量为 200 cc 的两轮摩托车在省道网上行驶。它允许移动的最高限速是多少？
1) 70 公里/小时。
√ 2) 90 公里/小时。
3) 100 公里/小时。

column1:
In a very hot weather, the pitch on the road surface may soften. Which parts of the motor-cycle are affected more?
1) Suspensions.
2) Braking.
3) Exhaust pipe.
column2:
在非常炎热的天气下，路面的沥青可能会变软。摩托车的哪些部分受影响最大？
1) 悬挂系统。
√ 2) 制动（刹车）性能。
3) 排气管。
column4:
At which level should the brake and clutch levers in the motor-cycle handlebars be?
1) Just above the handlebars.
2) Just below the handlebars.
3) At the level of the rider’s open palm, when they touch the handlebars.
column5:
摩托车车把上的刹车和离合器拉杆应处于什么位置？
1) 刚好在握把上方。
2) 刚好在握把下方。
√ 3) 当骑手手摸车把时，与张开的掌心平齐。
column7:
Which of the following accessories and components do not constitute motor-cyclist’s equipment?
1) Boots and gloves.
2) Accelerator and lights switch.
3) Waist belt and crash-helmet.
column8:
下列哪项附件或组件不属于摩托车手的个人装备？
1) 靴子和手套。
√ 2) 油门（Accelerator）和灯光开关。
3) 护腰带和头盔。
column10:
You are riding your motor-cycle and for some reason you get extremely irritated. What should you do?
1) Speed up ignoring your state.
2) Stop riding until you calm down.
3) Ride at a reduced speed.
column11:
你正在骑摩托车，由于某种原因你变得极其烦躁。你应该怎么办？
1) 无视情绪，加速行驶。
√ 2) 停止骑行，直到你冷静下来。
3) 降速行驶。
column13:
You notice that the rider of a motor-cycle is riding to show off and impress or participates in improvised races. What is the punishment for this offence?
1) Only a fine.
2) A fine and immediate taking away of the vehicle licence.
3) A fine and immediate taking away of the number plates of the motor-cycle and rider’s driving licence for 30 days by the person who certifies the offence.
column14:
如果你发现摩托车骑手为了炫耀、给人留下印象而骑行，或参加即兴比赛（飙车）。这种违法行为的处罚是什么？
1) 仅罚款。
2) 罚款并立即没收车辆行驶证。
√ 3) 罚款，并由执法人员立即扣留摩托车号牌及骑手驾驶证 30 天。
column16:
Riding you motor-cycle you are following a car. On which positions should you not be?
1) On the left of the car.
2) Just behind the car.
3) On the positions not covered by the car mirrors.
column17:
骑摩托车跟随一辆轿车时，你不应该处于什么位置？
1) 轿车的左侧。
2) 轿车的正后方。
√ 3) 轿车后视镜覆盖不到的位置（盲区）。
column19:
The chain of your motor-cycle needs periodical lubrication:
1) Yes, because thus wears are reduced and the temperature of both the chain and transmission gears falls.
2) No, because the engine takes care of its lubrication.
3) No, because thus it may come off the gears and immobilise the rear wheel.
column20:
摩托车链条需要定期润滑吗？
√ 1) 需要，因为这样可以减少磨损，并降低链条和传动齿轮的温度。
2) 不需要，因为发动机会负责其润滑。
3) 不需要，因为润滑可能导致链条脱落并卡死后轮。
column22:
A motor-cycle that develops a speed of over 40 km/h must have:
1) Up to two full beam headlights placed symmetrically, one close to the other.
2) It is not obligatory to have beam headlights.
3) Only dipped headlights.
column23:
时速能超过 40 公里/小时的摩托车必须配备：
√ 1) 最多两个对称放置、彼此靠近的远光灯。
2) 不强制配备远光灯。
3) 仅配备近光灯。

column1:
Which kinds of road do not create the risk of slipping?
1) White lines.
2) Dry asphalt.
3) Melted bitumen.
column2:
哪种路面不会产生打滑风险？
1) 白色标线。
√ 2) 干燥的沥青路面。
3) 融化的沥青。
column4:
Do you believe that the lights of the motor-cycle should be on also in the day-time?
1) Yes, because thus it is better visible by the drivers of other vehicles.
2) No, because the battery runs down.
3) No, because thus they limit the visibility of the drivers of other vehicles.
column5:
你认为摩托车在白天也应开灯吗？
√ 1) 是的，因为这样更容易被其他车辆的司机看到。
2) 不，因为会耗尽电池电量。
3) 不，因为这样会限制其他车辆司机的视线。
column7:
In a collision between a motor-cycle and a car, what do you think that protects the motor-cyclist?
1) Suitable clothes and suitable crash-helmet.
2) The small mass of the motor-cycle.
3) Their throwing off the motor-cycle.
column8:
在摩托车与汽车的碰撞中，你认为什么能保护摩托车手？
√ 1) 合适的衣服和合适的头盔。
2) 摩托车较小的质量。
3) 从摩托车上摔出去。
column10:
Why is it dangerous to ride a motor-cycle under the influence of even a small quantity of alcohol (e.g. a glass of beer):
1) Because sanctions may be inflicted upon you in case of a breath-test.
2) Because your reaction time is reduced.
3) Because the beer contains a big quantity of alcohol.
column11:
为什么摄入极少量酒精（如一杯啤酒）后骑摩托车是危险的？
1) 因为在吹气测试时可能会受到制裁。
√ 2) 因为你的反应时间会受到影响（变得迟钝）。
3) 因为啤酒含有大量酒精。
column13:
If by your motor-cycle you are carrying a big object, then this is allowed to jut out from?
1) Only the back side of the motor-cycle, by less than 0.50 m.
2) Both sides (right and left) of the motor-cycle, by less than 0.50 m.
3) The sides of the motor-cycle or the front or back end, by less than 0.50 m.
column14:
如果你用摩托车携带大宗物品，允许伸出的长度是？
1) 仅限摩托车后部，且小于 0.50 米。
2) 摩托车两侧（左右），均小于 0.50 米。
√ 3) 摩托车的前、后或两侧，伸出均不得超过 0.50 米。
column16:
At which positions around a lorry or a bus, is a motor-cycle not visible by the driver of the lorry or bus?
1) On the left and from the middle of its length backwards.
2) Just behind it.
3) On the right and from the middle of its length backwards.
column17:
在货车或公交车周围的哪些位置，摩托车手无法被货车或公交车司机看见？
1) 在其左侧且从中段向后的位置。
√ 2) 正后方。
3) 在其右侧且从中段向后的位置。
column19:
You notice that a motor-cycle is emitting substances or products which are harmful for human health or pollute the environment more than allowed. What is the punishment for this offence?
1) There is no consequence for such a breach of the law.
2) Only a fine.
3) A fine and the competent person who certifies the offence will immediately take away the number plates.
column20:
如果你发现摩托车排放有害健康的物质或对环境造成的污染超过允许范围，这种违法行为的处罚是什么？
1) 违反此类法律没有任何后果。
2) 仅处以罚款。
√ 3) 罚款，并由查处违法行为的授权人员立即没收车辆号牌。
column22:
Which is the maximum permissible speed limit for a two-wheeled motor-cycle with an engine of over 125 cc when moving in an expressway?
1) 50 km/h.
2) 110 km/h.
3) 70 km/h
column23:
排量超过 125 cc 的两轮摩托车在快速路（Expressway）上行驶时，最高允许限速是多少？
1) 50 公里/小时。
√ 2) 110 公里/小时。
3) 70 公里/小时。

column1:
Which are the main reasons for skidding?
1) Soft braking.
2) Excessive tilting on the bend or sudden braking or sudden change of direction.
3) Upright position on the bend.
column2:
导致打滑的主要原因是什么？
1) 轻柔制动。
√ 2) 弯道倾斜过度、突然制动或突然改变方向。
3) 在弯道保持直立姿势。
column4:
When you put a carrier at the back of the motor-cycle, what should you be very careful about?
1) It should be as front and low as possible, so as to affect less the centre of gravity.
2) It should be supported by the frame of the motor-cycle.
3) It should be quite wide so that the objects carried be fixed well.
column5:
在摩托车后部安装行李架（载物架）时，应该特别注意什么？
√ 1) 尽可能靠前且靠下，以减少对重心的影响。
2) 必须由摩托车车架支撑。
3) 必须足够宽，以便能固定好携带的物体。
column7:
Why must a motor-cyclist wear a crash-helmet?
1) Because it is required by the Law.
2) Because they run the risk of paying a fine.
3) Because in case of a fall, the consequences may be fatal, if they do not wear a crash-helmet.
column8:
为什么摩托车手必须佩戴头盔？
1) 因为法律要求。
2) 因为面临被罚款的风险。
√ 3) 因为如果不戴头盔，一旦摔倒，后果可能是致命的。
column10:
You notice that the braking system of your motor-cycle does not work efficiently. What should you do?
1) Ask the help of a friend who occasionally undertakes such task.
2) Repair it by yourself.
3) Refer to a repair workshop that operates legally for the repair and check of its proper function.
column11:
你发现摩托车的制动系统工作不正常，你应该怎么办？
1) 向偶尔从事此类工作的专业朋友寻求帮助。
2) 尝试自己修理。
√ 3) 前往合法经营的修理厂进行修理和功能检查。
column13:
When you are riding a motor-cycle you are not permitted:
1) To hold the handlebars with both hands.
2) To use headphones which have been connected with a portable radio or tape-player.
3) To move on the right end of the road.
column14:
骑摩托车时，你不被允许：
1) 用双手握住车把。
√ 2) 使用连接到便携式收音机或播放器的耳机。
3) 在道路右端行驶。
column16:
Riding your motor-cycle on an uphill you realize that the gear you have engaged is not strong enough, what should you do?
1) Semi-engage the clutch so that engine revolutions increase.
2) Drive on full throttle.
3) Change into a lower gear.
column17:
在上坡骑行时，如果你意识到所选档位动力不足，应该怎么办？
1) 半离合以增加发动机转速。
2) 全油门行驶。
√ 3) 换入低速档。
column19:
Does the fluid of the battery of your motor-cycle need to be checked, and if yes, what kind of check?
1) It needs to be checked whether the battery is charged enough.
2) It does not need a check.
3) The level of its fluids should be periodically checked and it should be filled with distilled water.
column20:
摩托车的蓄电池（电瓶）液需要检查吗？如果需要，如何检查？
1) 需要检查电池电量是否充足。
2) 不需要检查。
√ 3) 应定期检查液位，并应加注蒸馏水。
column22:
You are riding your motor-cycle at a steady speed and the braking system is in a good condition. On what does the stopping distance of the motor-cycle depend?
1) Weather conditions.
2) Type of brakes.
3) Condition of the road, your tyres and weather conditions.
column23:
你正以恒定速度骑行且刹车系统良好。摩托车的停车距离取决于什么？
1) 天气条件。
2) 刹车类型。
√ 3) 路面状况、轮胎状况和天气条件。

column1:
The best place to park your motor-cycle is on:
1) A soft asphalt covering.
2) A soft ground.
3) The grass.
4) A stable, level ground.
column2:
停放摩托车的最佳地点是：
1) 柔软的沥青路面。
2) 松软的地面。
3) 草地。
√ 4) 稳定且平坦的地面。
column4:
The dipped headlights of your motor-cycle must give sufficient light to the road in the night-time in fair weather conditions:
1) At least 10 m ahead of the motor-cycle.
2) At least 20 m ahead of the motor-cycle.
3) At least 40 m ahead of the motor-cycle.
column5:
在天气良好的夜间，摩托车的近光灯（Dipped headlights）必须至少能照亮前方：
1) 10 米。
2) 20 米。
√ 3) 40 米。
column7:
The motor-cyclist wears a special belt on his waist for:
1) Being supported better on the motor-cycle.
2) The support of their vertebral column and protection of their kidneys and other organs in the waist.
3) Beauty reasons.
column8:
摩托车手在腰部系专用护腰带是为了：
1) 更好地支撑在摩托车上。
√ 2) 支撑脊柱并保护腰部的肾脏及其他器官。
3) 为了美观。
column10:
In case of emergency, what pressure should you exercise on the brakes of the motor-cycle in order to immobilise it immediately?
1) There is no limit.
2) As mush as needed for the immobilisation of the rear wheel.
3) The highest which does not lock the wheels.
column11:
在紧急情况下，你应该对摩托车刹车施加多大的压力才能使其立即停稳？
1) 没有限制。
2) 只要能停住后轮所需的压力即可。
√ 3) 在不锁死车轮的前提下，施加最大的压力。
column13:
Why should a motor-cyclist not show off in the street with the motor-cycle they ride?
1) Because the persons seeing them are disturbed.
2) Because they run the risk of being given a ticket by a Traffic Police Officer.
3) Because such actions are very dangerous, the roads are also used by others, and we should not threaten others’ bodily integrity and life.
column14:
为什么摩托车手不应该在街上骑车炫耀？
1) 因为看到他们的人会受到干扰。
2) 因为他们面临被交警开罚单的风险。
√ 3) 因为此类行为非常危险，道路是供大家使用的，我们不应威胁他人的身体完整和生命。
column16:
Which is in your opinion the correct way to overtake a leading vehicle?
1) On the left or right at a high speed.
2) On the left as slow as possible.
3) On the left and, after making your presence and intention known, accelerating as fast as possible.
column17:
你认为超越前车的正确方式是：
1) 从左侧或右侧高速超越。
2) 尽可能慢地从左侧超越。
√ 3) 从左侧超越，并在表明自己的存在和意图后，尽快加速超越。
column19:
Do the wire ropes of the accelerator, clutch and brakes of the motor-cycle need lubrication?
1) No, because the manufacturer has ensured their lubrication.
2) They need periodical check and lubrication, because otherwise they become dry and are broken.
3) They need lubrication whenever the rider realises that they start tightening.
column20:
摩托车的油门、离合器和刹车的钢丝拉线（Wire ropes）需要润滑吗？
1) 不需要，因为制造商已确保了它们的润滑。
√ 2) 它们需要定期检查和润滑，否则会变干并断裂。
3) 每当骑手意识到拉线开始变紧时就需要润滑。
column22:
Which in your opinion is the safest position for a motor-cycle which travels in the highway in relation to the other vehicles?
1) Among a group of cars.
2) Well ahead of or behind the other cars.
3) The rightmost part of the road.
column23:
你认为行驶在高速公路上的摩托车相对于其他车辆最安全的位置是？
1) 处于一堆轿车中间。
√ 2) 远远领先于或落后于其他轿车（避开车流密集区）。
3) 道路的最右侧部分。

column1:
You had an accident and your pillion-passenger has been injured. What should you not do?
1) Take off the helmet.
2) Keep them warm.
3) Leave them where they are.
4) Take off their clothes.
column2:
发生了事故且你的后座乘客受伤了。你不应该做什么？
√ 1) 摘下他们的头盔。
2) 让他们保持温暖。
3) 让他们留在原位。
4) 脱掉他们的衣服。
column4:
The full beam headlights of a two-wheeled motor-cycle are:
1) White.
2) Green.
3) Red.
column5:
两轮摩托车的远光灯（Full beam）是什么颜色的？
√ 1) 白色。
2) 绿色。
3) 红色。
column7:
Which of the following will not make you more visible in the day-time?
1) A black crash-helmet.
2) A white crash-helmet.
3) Lights being on.
4) Clothes with reflectors.
column8:
下列哪项不能让你在白天更显眼？
√ 1) 黑色头盔。
2) 白色头盔。
3) 开启车灯行驶。
4) 穿着带有反光条的衣服。
column10:
In the town you are overtaking with your motor-cycle a stopped bus. What should you be very careful about?
1) Whether the bus will move off.
2) Whether a pedestrian will appear in front of the bus.
3) Both.
column11:
在城镇里，你正骑车超越一辆停在站点的公交车，你应该特别注意什么？
1) 公交车是否会起步。
2) 公交车前方是否会出现行人。
√ 3) 以上两者都是。
column13:
How should the pillion-passenger of a motor-cycle be supported?
1) By the carrier or the relevant accessory behind them.
2) By the rider, pressing their knees.
3) By stepping well on the footsteps and holding lightly but firmly the rider from the waist or the handle of the seat, if there is one.
column14:
摩托车后座乘客应该如何支撑自己？
1) 通过身后的货架或相关附件。
2) 通过双腿用力夹住骑手。
√ 3) 通过踩稳脚踏板，并轻柔但稳固地扶住骑手的腰部或座椅扶手（如果有的话）。
column16:
How should you round a bend open with your motor-cycle?
1) You should take the biggest possible curve, always within your lane at a steady speed.
2) You should take a curve increasing speed.
3) You should turn at continuous small angles.
column17:
你应该如何骑摩托车通过开阔的弯道？
√ 1) 在保持自己车道的前提下，尽可能以平稳的速度走最大的弧线（外-内-外）。
2) 增加速度来过弯。
3) 通过连续的小角度转动来过弯。
column19:
You notice that a motor-cycle during its movement and operation is making a bigger noise than that permitted. What is the punishment for this offence?
1) Only a fine.
2) A fine and the competent person who certifies the offence will immediately take away the number plates.
3) There is no consequence for such a breach of the law.
column20:
你发现摩托车在行驶和运转过程中产生的噪音超过了允许范围，这种违法行为的处罚是什么？
1) 仅处以罚款。
√ 2) 罚款，并由查处违法行为的授权人员立即没收车辆号牌。
3) 违反此类法律没有任何后果。
column22:
You see traffic signs that show a sharp right bend ahead. What should you do?
1) Continue at the same speed.
2) Slow down as you are within the bend.
3) Slow down as you are coming out of the bend.
4) Slow down before the bend.
column23:
你看到前方有右急转弯的交通标志。你应该怎么办？
1) 以相同的速度继续行驶。
2) 在弯道内减速。
3) 驶出弯道时减速。
√ 4) 进入弯道前减速。

column4:
The full beam headlight(s) of a motor-cycle must give sufficient light to the road in the night-time in fair weather conditions:
1) At least 50 m ahead of the motor-cycle.
2) At least 100 m ahead of the motor-cycle.
3) At least 70 m ahead of the motor-cycle.
column5:
在天气良好的夜间，摩托车的远光灯必须至少能照亮前方：
1) 50 米。
√ 2) 100 米。
3) 70 米。
column7:
You are riding a motor-cycle in a very hot weather. Then you should:
1) Ride with the gelatine of your crash-helmet fully open.
2) Continue to wear protective clothes.
3) Wear simple shoes instead of boots.
4) Loosen the strap of the crash-helmet.
column8:
在非常炎热的天气骑摩托车时，你应该：
1) 将头盔面罩完全打开骑行。
√ 2) 继续穿着防护服。
3) 穿普通的鞋子而不是靴子。
4) 调松头盔的带子。
column10:
Whilst riding your motor-cycle, a pedestrian that is crossing the street ahead of you suddenly stops in the middle of the street. What should you do?
1) Brake as harshly as possible.
2) Try to avoid them either by changing course or braking safely.
3) Try to overtake them.
column11:
你骑行时，前方横穿马路的行人突然停在路中间，你应该怎么办？
1) 尽可能猛力刹车。
√ 2) 尝试通过改变路线或安全制动来避开他们。
3) 尝试强行超越他们。
column13:
Is the pillion-passenger important for motor-cycle riding and why?
1) No, because they do not ride it.
2) Yes, because they affect its centre of gravity.
3) Yes, because the vehicle becomes heavier.
column14:
后座乘客对摩托车骑行重要吗？为什么？
1) 不重要，因为他们不负责驾驶。
√ 2) 重要，因为他们会影响车辆的重心。
3) 重要，因为车辆变得更重了。
column16:
In a motor-cycle group (group riding), which motor-cycle should be last?
1) Any motor-cycle.
2) The motor-cycle that is moving slower.
3) The motor-cycle that can be faster.
column17:
在摩托车车队骑行（组队）中，哪辆摩托车应该排在最后？
1) 任何摩托车都可以。
2) 行驶速度较慢的摩托车。
√ 3) 能够跑得更快的摩托车（以便随时跟上队伍或处理突发状况）。
column19:
Why do the shock absorbers (amortisseur) of a motor-cycle contain also oil:
1) In order to be noiseless and not wear out.
2) Because the oil makes the braking system elastic.
3) Because the shocks caused by the road roughness are better absorbed with the use of oil.
column20:
为什么摩托车的减震器（Shock absorbers）中也含有油？
1) 为了使其无噪音且不磨损。
2) 因为油能使制动系统具有弹性。
√ 3) 因为使用油可以更好地吸收路面不平产生的冲击。
column22:
You are riding a motor-cycle and following a large vehicle at a speed of 60 km/h. Which position should you take up?
1) You should approach the vehicle close so as to overtake it easily.
2) On the right side of the road so as to have visibility.
3) You should approach the vehicle close so as to be protected by the wind.
4) You should keep well behind so as to be able to have a view ahead of the vehicle.
column23:
你骑摩托车以 60 公里/小时的速度跟随一辆大型车辆。你应该占据什么位置？
1) 靠近该车以便轻松超车。
2) 在道路右侧以便获得视野。
3) 靠近该车以躲避强风。
√ 4) 保持较远距离，以便能够看到该车前方的路况。

column1: 最后动作：无论是汽车还是摩托车，变道或转弯前的最后动作永远是“转头扫视盲区 (Shoulder check/Look over shoulder)”。
column2: 沥青变软：希腊夏天极热，沥青变软会像橡皮擦一样降低抓地力，直接影响刹车距离。
column4:
A basic modification to your motor-cycle:
1) Does not affect the safety of riding your motor-cycle.
2) Is dangerous, as long as it has been made without the standards of the manufacturer having been observed.
3) You may make it by yourself.
column5:
对摩托车进行基础性改装（Basic modification）：
1) 不影响骑行安全。
√ 2) 如果不遵守制造商标准是很危险的。
3) 你可以自己随意改装。
column7:
Why should you wear clothes with reflectors in the day-time?
1) Because they reduce the pressure from the air.
2) Because they restrict injuries in case you fall off.
3) Because they make you more visible by the other drivers.
4) Because they keep you cool, when the weather is hot.
column8:
为什么在白天也应该穿着带有反光条的衣服？
1) 因为它们能减少空气阻力。
2) 因为它们能限制摔倒时的伤害。
√ 3) 因为它们让你更容易被其他司机看到。
4) 因为天气炎热时它们能让你保持凉爽。
column10:
If a vehicle coming from the opposite direction has its headlights on full beam and as a consequence you cannot see:
1) You should switch on the full beam headlights of your motor-cycle as well.
2) You should close the accelerator, switch on your dipped headlights and follow the horizontal lines riding as right as possible.
3) You should brake.
column11:
如果对向车辆开启远光灯导致你看不清前方：
1) 你也应该开启摩托车的远光灯。
√ 2) 你应该松开油门，切换为近光灯，并盯着道路右侧的水平线行驶（避开强光直射）。
3) 你应该刹车。
column13:
What is the correct position for the body of a motor-cycle pillion-passenger?
1) Close to the rider’s body, following their movements.
2) It should remain always in a vertical position.
3) Slightly leaning back.
column14:
摩托车后座乘客身体的正确姿势是？
√ 1) 贴近骑手的身体，并跟随骑手的动作（同步倾斜）。
2) 始终保持垂直姿势。
3) 稍微向后靠。
column16:
Riding your motor-cycle when raining, what should you have in mind in order to ride safely?
1) Avoid the parts of the road which have much water.
2) Not to apply the front brake.
3) Since the stopping distance becomes longer in case of braking, you must keep longer distances than usual.
column17:
雨天骑摩托车时，为了安全骑行你应该注意什么？
1) 避开路面积水较多的部分。
2) 不要使用前刹车。
√ 3) 由于制动时的停车距离变长，你必须保持比平时更远的距离。
column19:
Should you change tyre pressure according to the weather?
1) Yes. Increase pressure in cold weather.
2) Yes. Increase pressure in hot weather.
3) No. Use always the same pressure ensuring that the pressure is measured when the tyres are cold.
column20:
你应该根据天气改变轮胎气压吗？
1) 是的，寒冷天气增加气压。
2) 是是的，炎热天气增加气压。
√ 3) 不应该。始终使用相同的气压，并确保在轮胎冷却时测量气压。
column22:
You should not ride behind and very close to a lorry, because:
1) You will breathe its exhaust gases.
2) The air-stream of the lorry will drop you off.
3) The drivers behind you will not be able to see you.
4) Your visibility ahead is reduced.
column23:
你不应该紧跟在大货车后面，因为：
1) 你会吸入它的废气。
2) 货车产生的气流会把你吹倒。
3) 你身后的司机将无法看到你。
√ 4) 你观察前方的视野会降低。

column1: 摩托车停车：摩托车很重且支架受力点小，必须停在硬实平整的地面，否则支架会陷进软沥青或泥土里导致倒车。
column2: 急救禁忌：在摩托车事故中，除非有窒息风险，否则绝对不能摘下伤者的头盔，因为这可能导致脊椎或颈椎二次损伤致残。
column4:
Motor-cycles and mopeds must be fitted with:
1) Two braking systems to act on both wheels.
2) One braking system to act on the rear wheels.
3) One braking system to act on the front wheels.
column5:
摩托车和轻便摩托车必须配备：
√ 1) 作用于前后轮的两套独立制动（刹车）系统。
2) 一套作用于后轮的制动系统。
3) 一套作用于前轮的制动系统。
column7:
Which of the following make motor-cyclists better visible by the other road users?
1) Clothes with reflectors.
2) A grey crash-helmet.
3) Black leather clothes.
column8:
下列哪项能让摩托车手更容易被其他道路使用者看到？
√ 1) 带有反光条的衣服。
2) 灰色头盔。
3) 黑色皮衣。
column10:
You are riding at night and you are dazzled by the lights of an oncoming vehicle. What should you do?
1) Slow down or stop.
2) Close your eyes.
3) Flash the full beam headlights.
4) Turn your head to another direction.
column11:
你在夜间骑行，被对向来车的灯光晃得眩目，你应该怎么办？
√ 1) 减速或停车。
2) 闭上眼睛。
3) 闪烁远光灯示警。
4) 将头转向另一个方向。
column13:
Your indicators may not be visible due to the garish sunlight. What should you do?
1) You should switch on the indicator earlier.
2) In addition to the indicators you should give an arm signal in order to show that you intend to turn.
3) You should press the rear footbrake some times so that the brake light switches on.
4) You should turn very quickly.
column14:
由于阳光刺眼，你的转向灯可能看不清。你应该怎么办？
1) 应该更早开启转向灯。
√ 2) 除了开启转向灯，还应给出手臂信号以表明转弯意图。
3) 应该反复踩踏后刹车，使刹车灯闪烁。
4) 应该非常快速地转弯。
column16:
Which wheel must lock so that your motor-cycle stop as soon as possible?
1) The front wheel.
2) None.
3) The rear wheel.
column17:
为了让摩托车尽快停下，哪个车轮必须锁死？
1) 前轮。
√ 2) 任何车轮都不应锁死（锁死会导致打滑失控）。
3) 后轮。
column19:
Which of the following checks which concern your motor-cycle should be performed in a specialised repair workshop that operates legally?
1) Check of the sparking-plug only.
2) Check of the sparking-plug, chain tension, and in particular, check of the carburettor.
3) Check of the chain tension only.
column20:
下列哪项摩托车检查应在合法经营的专业修理厂进行？

3) 仅检查链条张紧度。
column22:
You are approaching a road whose surface is covered by fine gravel. What should you do?
1) Ride as normal.
2) Speed up.
3) Slow down.
4) Stop.
column23:
你正接近一段路面覆盖着细碎石的路段。你应该怎么办？
1) 正常骑行。
2) 加速。
√ 3) 减速。
4) 停车。

column4:
Whilst riding you notice that your shoulders obstruct the visibility through your mirrors. What should you do?
1) Extend the arms of the mirrors.
2) Put smaller mirrors.
3) Turn on your indicators earlier than usual.
4) Not use the mirrors.
column5:
行驶中你发现肩膀挡住了后视镜的视野，你应该怎么办？
√ 1) 加长后视镜的支架臂。
2) 换更小的镜子。
3) 比平时更早开启转向灯。
4) 不使用后视镜。
column7:
Which of the following make motor-cyclists better visible by the other road users?
1) A white crash-helmet.
2) A grey crash-helmet.
3) Black leather clothes.
column8:
下列哪项能让摩托车手更容易被其他道路使用者看到？
√ 1) 白色头盔。
2) 灰色头盔。
3) 黑色皮衣。
column10:
You are moving towards a pedestrian crossing and pedestrians are waiting to cross the road. What should you do?
1) Allow the elderly to pass.
2) Slow down and prepare to stop.
3) Use the full beam headlights in order to show them to pass.
4) Nod them to pass.
column11:
你正驶向人行横道，行人正在路边等待过马路，你应该怎么办？
1) 允许老人通过。
√ 2) 减速并准备停车。
3) 使用远光灯示意他们通过。
4) 向他们点头示意通过。
column13:
How should you show with your hands that you wish to turn left?
1) Extending stably your right arm.
2) Extending stably and to the side your left arm.
3) Moving up and down your extended left arm.
4) Moving up and down your extended right arm.
column14:
你应该如何用手势表示你打算左转？
1) 稳定地伸出你的右手。
√ 2) 稳定地向侧面伸出你的左手。
3) 上下移动伸出的左手。
4) 上下移动伸出的右手。
column16:
What is considered to be the correct position when riding a motor-cycle?
1) Knees tight to the petrol tank, feet stepping well on the footsteps and hands holding firmly the handlebars.
2) Knees open, because thus the centre of gravity is easier affected.
3) The position is not important.
column17:
骑摩托车时的正确姿势被认为是：
√ 1) 双膝紧贴油箱，双脚稳踩脚踏板，双手紧握车把。
2) 双膝张开，因为这样更容易影响重心。
3) 姿势并不重要。
column19:
The shock absorbers of your motor-cycle present an oil leak. What should you do?
1) Ensure that the oil does not reach the brakes or wheels.
2) Ensure that the oil does not reach the brakes or wheels and repair immediately the leak, because the performance of the motor-cycle changes.
3) You should not worry immediately, because they have enough oil and it will take some time until they are damaged due to the lack of oil.
column20:
摩托车的减震器出现漏油。你应该怎么办？
1) 确保油不会流到刹车或车轮上。
√ 2) 确保油不会流到刹车或车轮上，并立即修复泄漏，因为这会改变摩托车的性能。
3) 不需要立即担心，因为油量足够，需要一段时间才会因缺油而损坏。
column22:
A two-wheeled motor-cycle with an engine of 120 cc is moving in an expressway. Which is the maximum speed limit at which it is permitted to move?
1) 110 km/h.
2) 80 km/h.
3) 90 km/h.
column23:
一辆排量为 120 cc 的两轮摩托车在快速路（Expressway）上行驶。它允许移动的最高限速是多少？
1) 110 公里/小时。
√  2) 80 公里/小时。
3) 90 公里/小时。

column4:
Which of the following make motor-cyclists better visible by the other road users?
1) Use of lights.
2) A grey crash-helmet.
3) Black leather clothes.
column5:
下列哪项能让摩托车手更容易被其他道路使用者看到？
√ 1) 使用灯光。
2) 佩戴灰色头盔。
3) 穿着黑色皮衣。
column7:
Your crash-helmet has a small crack. What should be done?
1) You should change the crash-helmet before riding again.
2) You should be riding at a low speed only.
3) You should ask the police to check it.
4) A rider should repair it.
column8:
你的头盔有一个小裂纹。应该怎么办？
√ 1) 在再次骑行前更换头盔。
2) 只能低速骑行。
3) 请求警察检查。
4) 骑手应自行修理。
column10:
You are riding in a central street, which crosses many smaller streets. Why should you be very careful?
1) Because gusts of wind from the side streets may drop you off.
2) Because the drivers from side streets may not notice you.
3) Because the street in which you are riding may be slippery, since vehicles turn.
4) Because the drivers slow down before turning.
column11:
你在一条穿过许多小巷的中心大街上骑行，为什么你应该非常小心？
1) 因为从小巷刮来的阵风可能会把你吹倒。
√ 2) 因为小巷出来的司机可能注意不到你（摩托车体积小）。
3) 因为车辆转弯可能会导致路面湿滑。
4) 因为司机在转弯前会减速。
column13:
After showing with your left hand that you are turning left, why should you lower it whilst turning?
1) Because you may hit a pedestrian.
2) Because otherwise you cannot steer the motor-cycle so well.
3) Because you will need to press the lever of the clutch.
4) Because the other drivers will think that you will stop on the corner.
column14:
用左手示意左转后，为什么在实际转弯时应该放回手？
1) 因为你可能会撞到行人。
√ 2) 因为否则你无法很好地操控摩托车（需双手控车）。
3) 因为你需要捏离合器拉杆。
4) 因为其他司机会以为你要在街角停车。
column16:
On a steep downhill, which gear of the motor-cycle should be engaged?
1) First.
2) Second.
3) The gear in which you ascend the same part of the road or part of another road with a similar gradient.
column17:
在陡峭的下坡路上，摩托车应挂入哪个档位？
1) 一档。
2) 二档。
√ 3) 与你爬上同一段路或相同坡度路段时所用的档位相同。
column19:
In case you use a sparking plug in your motor-cycle which is different from that provided for by its manufacturer, what may happen?
1) The engine may not work and the ignition system may fail.
2) The engine may sustain a damage.
3) The braking system may not work.
column20:
如果你在摩托车上使用了与制造商规定不同的火花塞，可能会发生什么？
√  1) 发动机可能不工作且点火系统可能失效。
2) 发动机可能会遭受损坏。
3) 制动系统可能不工作。
column22:
Which is the maximum permissible speed limit for a two-wheeled motor-cycle with an engine of over 125 cc, when moving in a motorway?
1) 60 km/h.
2) 75 km/h.
3) 130 km/h.
column23:
排量超过 125 cc 的两轮摩托车在高速公路（Motorway）上行驶时，最高允许限速是多少？
1) 60 公里/小时。
2) 75 公里/小时。
√ 3) 130 公里/小时。

column4:
Which types of protective constructions protect better?
1) Windscreen on the handlebars.
2) Sport fairing.
3) Tourist fairing.
column5:
哪种类型的防护结构能提供更好的保护？
1) 车把上的挡风镜。
2) 运动版导流罩（Sport fairing）。
√ 3) 旅行版导流罩（Tourist fairing）。
column7:
If the visor of your crash-helmet is badly scratched, then you should:
1) Shine it with a polish.
2) Replace it.
3) Wash it with soap.
4) Clean it with diesel oil.
column8:
如果头盔的面罩磨损严重且有划痕，你应该：
1) 用抛光剂抛光。
√ 2) 更换面罩。
3) 用肥皂清洗。
4) 用柴油清洁。
column10:
You are riding in a provincial road where there are oxen and cows. What should you do?
1) You should slow down and stop if necessary.
2) You should accelerate.
3) You should sound the horn.
4) You should ride close to them.
column11:
你在一条有牛群经过的省道上骑行，你应该怎么办？
√ 1) 你应该减速，必要时停车。
2) 你应该加速。
3) 你应该鸣笛。
4) 你应该靠近它们骑行。
column13:
Which documents should you always carry with you, whilst riding your motor-cycle?
1) Driving licence, vehicle registration licence, insurance policy, road tax disc.
2) Road tax disc, vehicle registration licence.
3) Insurance policy, driving licence.
column14:
骑摩托车时，你应该始终随身携带哪些证件？
√ 1) 驾驶证、车辆登记证（行驶证）、保险单、路税单（注：希腊目前部分证件可使用电子版）。
2) 路税单、车辆登记证。
3) 保险单、驾驶证。
column16:
You are riding your motor-cycle and you are approaching a bend. What should you do?
1) You should speed up so as to negotiate the bend quickly.
2) You should speed up, tilt approaching the ground and negotiate the bend.
3) You should check the road, take up the correct position and adjust your speed and gear.
column17:
你正骑车接近弯道。你应该怎么办？
1) 加速以便快速通过弯道。
2) 加速，倾斜压弯并掠过地面。
√ 3) 检查路况，占据正确位置，并调整速度和档位。
column19:
How often should you check the oil level of your motor-cycle?
1) Before every use.
2) Every 1000 km.
3) Every 2000 km.
column20:
你应该多久检查一次摩托车的机油量？
√ 1) 每次使用前。
2) 每 1,000 公里。
3) 每 2,000 公里。
column22:
A two-wheeled motor-cycle with an engine of 80 cc is moving in a motor-way. Which is the maximum permissible speed limit at which it can move?
1) 45 km/h.
2) 80 km/h.
3) 100 km/h.
column23:
一辆排量为 80 cc 的两轮摩托车在高速公路（Motorway）上行驶。它允许移动的最高限速是多少？
1) 45 公里/小时。
√ 2) 80 公里/小时。
3) 100 公里/小时。

column4:
Which types of protective constructions protect better?
1) Windscreen on the handlebars.
2) Sport fairing.
3) Stable windscreen.
column5:
哪种类型的防护结构能提供更好的保护？
1) 车把上的挡风镜。
2) 运动版导流罩。
√ 3) 固定式挡风玻璃（Stable windscreen）。
column7:
What should you do to remain warm when driving in a very cold weather?
1) Drive very close to the leading cars.
2) Wear suitable clothes.
3) Bend low over the petrol tank.
4) Put sometimes your hands on the exhaust pipe.
column8:
在非常寒冷的天气驾驶时，你应该如何保持温暖？
1) 紧跟前车驾驶。
√ 2) 穿着合适的衣服。
3) 身体低俯在油箱上。
4) 有时把手放在排气管上。
column10:
It is very cold and the road seems to be wet. No rolling noise is heard. What should you do?
1) You should continue to ride at the same speed.
2) You should ride slowly having engaged the lowest gear you can.
3) You should slow down, because you may be riding on black ice.
column11:
天气非常冷，路面看起来是湿的，但听不到轮胎滚动的噪音（异常安静）。你应该怎么办？
1) 继续以同样的速度骑行。
2) 挂入你能使用的最低档位慢行。
√ 3) 你应该减速，因为你可能正行驶在“黑冰”（透明薄冰）上。
column13:
Everything loaded on the motor-cycle should be:
1) Safely fastened.
2) Carried only when necessary.
3) As light as possible.
4) Covered by a plastic bag.
column14:
摩托车上装载的所有物品都应该：
√ 1) 安全牢固地扎紧。
2) 仅在必要时携带。
3) 尽可能轻。
4) 用塑料袋覆盖。
column16:
At which point around a passenger car may a motor-cycle not be noticed by the car driver?
1) On the left only.
2) When it moves in the blind spots of mirrors of the car.
3) Just behind the car.
column17:
在轿车周围的哪个点，摩托车手可能不被轿车司机注意到？
1) 仅在左侧。
√ 2) 当它移动到轿车后视镜的盲区时。
3) 紧贴在轿车正后方。
column19:
Does a worn or broken exhaust pipe affect negatively engine performance?
1) No, it does not affect it.
2) Yes, it affects it by changing unexpectedly the horsepower, increasing the noise and reducing the life of the engine.
3) Yes, it affects it positively.
column20:
磨损或损坏的排气管会负面影响发动机性能吗？
1) 不会，没有影响。
√ 2) 会的，它会意外改变马力、增加噪音并缩短发动机寿命。
3) 会的，它会有正面影响。

column4:
The side support (stand) of your motor-cycle has not been duly closed and you start. What may happen?
1) The centre of gravity of the motor-cycle may change.
2) Your foot may be caught.
3) The support may drag on the ground when you are turning and thus the motor-cycle may overturn.
4) It may cause a riding problem.
column5:
摩托车的侧支架（侧脚撑）没收起你就起步了，可能会发生什么？
1) 摩托车的重心可能改变。
2) 可能会夹到你的脚。
√ 3) 转弯时支架可能会刮到地面，导致摩托车翻车。
4) 可能会引起驾驶问题。
column7:
What should you do in order to be able to see in the night-time?
1) Leave a gap between your glasses or the visor.
2) Keep your glasses and visor clean.
3) Use a dark visor.
4) Do not use glasses or visor at all.
column8:
为了在夜间能够看清，你应该：
1) 在眼镜或面罩之间留个缝。
√ 2) 保持眼镜和面罩清洁。
3) 使用深色面罩。
4) 完全不使用眼镜或面罩。
column13:
When you are loading the motor-cycle, you should:
1) Load your things as back as possible from the rear axle.
2) Load your things as close as possible to its centre of gravity.
3) Hold the things tight with your hands.
column14:
当你给摩托车装载物品时，你应该：
1) 将物品装在尽可能远离后轴的位置。
√ 2) 将物品装在尽可能靠近重心（Center of gravity）的位置。
3) 用手紧紧抓住物品。
column16:
Your last action before making a U-turn in the road should be?
1) You should look over your shoulder for a last check.
2) You should give a signal, so that the other drivers slow down for you.
3) You should give an arm signal and simultaneously switch on the indicator.
4) You should select a higher gear than normal.
column17:
在马路上掉头（U-turn）前的最后一个动作应该是？
√ 1) 扭头向后方看，进行最后一次确认。
2) 给出信号，让其他司机为你减速。
3) 给出大手臂信号并同时开启转向灯。
4) 选择比平时更高的档位。
column19:
A worn or broken exhaust pipe may cause damage to the engine of the motor-cycle:
1) It affects negatively the performance of the engine, in particular, if it is two-stroke.
2) It does not cause damage to the engine, but it deregulates the engine.
3) It does not create any problem.
column20:
磨损或损坏的排气管可能损坏摩托车发动机：
√ 1) 它会负面影响发动机性能，特别是对于二冲程发动机。
2) 它不会损坏发动机，但会使发动机失调。
3) 它不会产生任何问题。
column22:

column23: 120cc 虽然接近 125cc，但在考试中它被归类为“小排量”，限速比 200cc 的要低。

column4:
You should not move with your clutch pressed longer than necessary, because:
1) The wear of the gear-box is increased.
2) Fuel consumption is increased.
3) The control of your motor-cycle is reduced.
4) The tyre grip on the road is reduced.
column5:
你不应该长时间捏着离合器滑行，因为：
1) 变速箱的磨损会增加。
2) 油耗会增加。
√ 3) 你对摩托车的控制力会下降。
4) 轮胎的抓地力会降低。
column7:
You are riding at night. What should you do in order to be distinguishable?
1) You should ride having the lights on.
2) You should wear cloths with reflectors.
3) You should have your motor-cycle cleaned.
4) You should clearly ride on the left part of the road.
5) You should wear bright-coloured clothes.
column8:
你在夜间骑行。为了让自己更容易被辨认，你应该：
1) 开启车灯。
√ 2) 穿着带有反光条的衣服。
3) 保持摩托车清洁。
4) 明显在道路左侧骑行。
5) 穿着鲜艳颜色的衣服。
column10: 黑冰 (Black Ice)：这是一个希腊北方或山区冬季常考的考点。如果路面看起来湿润但开起来没有噪音 (No rolling noise)，这说明轮胎已经离开了沥青走在冰上了，必须极其小心。
column11: 油渍 (Oil stain)：在希腊，老旧车辆漏油严重。如果你已经踩上油渍了，千万不能紧急转向或刹车，否则瞬间滑倒。正确答案是“松油门、直行通过”。
column13:
Whilst loading the motor-cycle, you should:
1) Load your things as back as possible from the rear axle.
2) Not exceed the loading limit determined by the manufacturer.
3) Hold the things tight with your hands.
column14:
在摩托车装载过程中，你应该：
1) 将物品装在尽可能远离后轴的位置。
√ 2) 不得超过制造商规定的载重限制。
3) 用手紧紧抓住物品。
column16:
Your last action just before moving off safely from the parking place is:
1) To let the other drivers know that they need to slow down.
2) Not to look around, as long as there is a parked car just in front of you.
3) To give an arm signal and at the same time switch on the indicators.
4) To look over your shoulder for a last check.
column17:
从停车位安全起步驶出前的最后一个动作是：
1) 让其他司机知道他们需要减速。
2) 只要前面有车停着，就不需要看周围。
√  3) 给出大手臂信号并同时开启转向灯。
4) 扭头向后方看，进行最后一次确认。
column19:
For traffic safety, which of the following should be carried out by a repair workshop that operates legally:
1) Cleaning of the petrol filter.
2) Lubrication of the chain.
3) Check of the braking system, suspensions and engine operation.
column20:
为了交通安全，下列哪项应由合法经营的修理厂完成？
1) 清洗燃油滤清器。
2) 润滑链条。
√ 3) 检查制动系统、悬挂系统和发动机运转情况。
column22: 碎石路（Gravel）对摩托车非常危险，答案永远是减速。
column23: 跟随大型车辆，视野永远比挡风更重要，所以要保持远距离 (Keep well behind)。

column7:
You do not have the proper equipment and you are riding a motor-cycle in a rainy and cold weather. What may happen?
1) You may lose your concentration and your attention.
2) Your visor may freeze.
3) You may slip from the saddle.
4) Your reaction time may be reduced.
5) Your helmet may loosen.
column8:
如果你在雨天和寒冷天气骑摩托车且没有合适的装备，可能会发生什么？
√ 1) 你可能会失去专注力和注意力。
2) 你的面罩可能会结冰。
3) 你可能会从座垫上滑下来。
4) 你的反应时间可能会减少。
5) 你的头盔可能会松动。
column10: 摩托车能见度：在主路行驶时，侧方小路车辆看不见你是摩托车事故主因，所以答案通常选“别人可能注意不到你”。
column11: 反应时间：酒精会增加 (Increase/Lengthen) 反应时间（即反应变慢），但在部分翻译中可能使用“降低效率”之类的措辞，注意区分。
column13:
The pillion-passenger should:
1) Give instructions to the rider.
2) Tilt with the rider on bends.
3) Check the road behind.
4) Show with their hands the intention to change direction.
column14:
后座乘客应该：
1) 给骑手指路。
√ 2) 在弯道处与骑手一起倾斜。
3) 检查后方道路。
4) 用手势示意改变方向的意图。
column16:
When riding a motor-cycle your usual position in the road should allow you:
1) To be visible by the other vehicles ahead of you.
2) To be visible in the mirrors of the vehicle ahead of you.
3) To delay the vehicles that wish to overtake.
4) To let vehicles coming overtake you on the right.
5) To remain at a distance of 0.50 m from the pavement.
column17:
骑摩托车时，在路上的常规行驶位置应能让你：
1) 被前方车辆看到。
√ 2) 出现在前方车辆的后视镜中。
3) 阻碍想超车的车辆。
4) 让来车从你的右侧超越。
5) 保持距离人行道 0.50 米。
column19:
When the driving chain is loose, then:
1) The front wheel may brake.
2) A power-cut of the ignition may occur.
3) The brakes may sustain a damage.
4) The rear wheel may be immobilised.
column20:
当传动链条过松时：
1) 前轮可能会制动。
2) 可能会导致点火断电。
3) 刹车可能会遭受损坏。
√ 4) 后轮可能会被卡死（链条脱轨）。

column4: 白天开灯：希腊法律强制或强烈建议摩托车白天开灯，唯一目的是**“被看见” (To be visible)**。
column5: 灯光距离：这和汽车标准一致，近光 40米，远光 100米。
column7:
The pillion-passengers should:
1) Have a driving licence.
2) Be lighter than the rider.
3) Wear a helmet.
4) Wear clothes with reflectors.
column8:
后座乘客（Pillion-passengers）应该：
1) 拥有驾驶证。
2) 比驾驶员更轻。
√ 3) 佩戴头盔。
4) 穿着带有反光条的衣服。
column13:
You can take a pillion-passenger on your motor-cycle, provided that:
1) There is a suitable saddle for two persons, footsteps for the pillion passenger and provision in the motor-cycle licence.
2) The engine has a capacity of over 250 cc.
3) Only if the pillion-passenger is lighter than the rider.
column14:
你可以载一名后座乘客，前提是：
√ 1) 拥有适合两人乘坐的座垫、乘客脚踏板，且摩托车行驶证上注明准载两人。
2) 发动机排量超过 250 cc。
3) 仅当后座乘客比骑手轻时。
column16:
You wish to turn right. Why should you take up the correct position in the road in good time?
1) So as to allow other drivers to turn ahead of you.
2) So as to be able to see better the road where you will turn.
3) To let the other drivers know how you are going to act.
4) So as to allow the other drivers to overtake you on the left.
column17:
你打算右转。为什么你应该及早占据道路上的正确位置？
1) 为了让其他司机在你前面转弯。
2) 为了能更好地看清你要转入的道路。
√ 3) 为了让其他司机知道你打算如何行动。
4) 为了让其他司机从你的左侧超越。
column19:
How often should you check your tyre pressure?
1) Only at every regular maintenance.
2) After every long journey.
3) Once a month.
4) Once a week.
column20:
你应该多久检查一次轮胎气压？
1) 仅在每次定期保养时。
2) 每次长途旅行后。
3) 每月一次。
√ 4) 每周一次。

column4: 侧脚撑 (Stand)：这是一个经典杀手，忘收脚撑在转弯（尤其是左转）时会瞬间把车顶起来导致翻车。
column5: 制动系统：摩托车必须有两个互相独立的刹车系统，分别控制前后轮。
column16:
Which actions of the rider cause serious damage to the tyres of the motor-cycle?
1) Braking.
2) Turning.
3) Gear changing.
4) Parking.
column17:
骑手的哪些动作会对摩托车轮胎造成严重损害？
√ 1) 紧急制动（刹车）。
2) 转弯。
3) 换档。
4) 停车。
column19:
The tread of the tyres must have at least the following depth:
1) 2,5 mm.
2) 4 mm.
3) 1 mm.
4) 1,6 mm.
column20:
摩托车轮胎花纹深度必须至少为：
1) 2.5 毫米。
2) 4 毫米。
√ 3) 1 毫米。
4) 1.6 毫米。

column4: 重心：安装任何行李箱都必须遵循“低和前”的原则，否则高速行驶时车头会剧烈晃动（死亡摇摆）。
column7: 头盔 (Helmet)：这是最重要的装备。即便有微小裂纹 (Small crack) 或面罩划痕 (Scratched visor)，也必须更换。
column8: 安全性大于舒适度：即便是在炎热夏季 (Very hot weather)，也必须穿防护服和靴子，不能穿短裤或凉鞋。
column13: 炫耀/飙车处罚：在希腊这属于严重违章，直接扣证、扣牌 30天 还要交巨额罚款。
column14: 装载极限：前后左右伸出均不能超过 0.50 米。
column16:
You are riding your motor-cycle in very good weather and road conditions. The most efficient way to immobilise your motor-cycle through the brakes is:
1) Apply both brakes (front and rear). Use the rear more.
2) To brake by applying equal pressure on both brakes.
3) To apply the rear brake and just before stopping, apply the front brake.
4) To apply both brakes with emphasis on the front.
column17:
你在极佳的天气和路况下骑行。通过刹车使摩托车停稳的最有效方式是：
1) 同时使用前后刹车，多用后刹。
2) 对前后刹车施加相等的压力。
3) 先用后刹，快停下时用前刹。
√ 4) 同时使用前后刹车，重点施加在前刹上。
column19:
Your motor-cycle has tyres with air chambers. Therefore:
1) You should replace the air chambers every 6 months.
2) You should replace the air chambers every 10,000 km.
3) You should replace the air chambers every time you change the rear tyre.
4) You should replace the air chambers every time you change the tyres.
column20:
你的摩托车轮胎带有内胎。因此：
1) 你应每 6 个月更换一次内胎。
2) 你应每 10,000 公里更换一次内胎。
3) 每次更换后胎时应更换内胎。
√ 4) 每次更换轮胎时都应更换内胎。

column7: 被视性 (Visibility)：为了在白天和黑夜都容易被看见，应选择白色头盔、反光服或鲜艳衣服。黑色是安全的大忌。
column8: 护腰带 (Waist belt)：不仅仅是为了支撑，更重要的是保护肾脏 (Kidneys) 和脊柱免受震动和冲击伤害。
column13: 后座乘客配合：乘客是摩托车的一部分，必须跟随骑手倾斜 (Tilt with the rider)，不能保持垂直或反向用力。
column14: 手臂信号：在强光下灯光看不清时，手臂信号是法律要求的补充手段。左手平伸代表左转。
column16:
The leading vehicle is being driven by a learner driver. You should:
1) Remain cool and be patient.
2) Ride behind them and very close to them.
3) Switch on your full beam lights.
4) Sound the horn and overtake.
column17:
前方车辆由实习司机（学车）驾驶。你应该：
√ 1) 保持冷静并耐心。
2) 紧跟在他们后面。
3) 开启远光灯。
4) 鸣笛并超车。
column19:
You have to travel in the fog. What are the most important things you must do?
1) Buy fuel.
2) Take a hot drink with you.
3) Check the lights, battery and clean the visor of your crash-helmet.
column20:
你必须在雾天旅行。最重要的准备工作是什么？
1) 购买燃油。
2) 随身携带热饮。
√ 3) 检查灯光、蓄电池并清洁头盔面罩。

column7: 后座乘客：法律对乘客唯一强制的要求是必须佩戴头盔。
column13: 耳机禁令：骑行时严禁佩戴耳机（即便只戴一个也不行）。
column16:
You are riding behind a long vehicle. Ahead of you there is a mini roundabout. The leading vehicle has its right indicator on, however, it is taking up a position on the left side of the road. You should:
1) Sound the horn.
2) Overtake it on the right.
3) Stay behind it until it finishes its manoeuvres.
4) Flash your lights.
column17:
你行驶在一辆长车（如大货车）后面，前方是一个小型环岛。前车开了右转向灯，但它却占据了道路左侧的位置。你应该：
1) 鸣笛。
2) 从右侧超越它。
√ 3) 留在它后面，直到它完成操作（它在走大弯）。
4) 闪烁大灯。

column16:
During usual riding in the road you should be:
1) 30 cm away from the pavement.
2) Just on the right of the middle of your lane.
3) On the right part of your lane.
4) Near the middle of the road.
column17:
在路上的常规骑行中，你应该处于：
1) 距离人行道 30 厘米处。
√ 2) 刚好处于你车道中心线的右侧一点。
3) 在你车道的右侧部分。
4) 靠近道路中间。
column19: 链条间隙：记住 2-3 厘米。这是最标准的链条松紧度。
column20: 机油检查频率：摩托车比汽车更娇气，官方标准是每次使用前 (Before every use) 检查机油。

column16:
You are entering a highway from a side road. What should you do?
1) Adjust your speed to that of the vehicles that are moving in the highway.
2) Accelerate as fast as possible and ride straight ahead.
3) Drive close to the side of the highway looking for an empty space.
4) Switch on the indicators.
column17:
你正从侧路进入干线公路。你应该怎么办？
√ 1) 将你的速度调整到与干线公路上行驶的车辆一致。
2) 尽可能快地加速并直行。
3) 靠近公路边缘行驶并寻找空隙。
4) 开启转向灯。
column19: 处罚规定：在希腊，排气管噪音大或排烟超标，处罚是罚款+没收号牌。
column20: 轮胎花纹深度：汽车是 1.6 毫米，摩托车是 1 毫米。这是两类考题的重要区别。

column16:
When the motor-cycle wobbles or moves like a snake, you should:
1) Close progressively the accelerator and reduce speed.
2) Leave the handlebars and let the motor-cycle stabilise by itself.
3) Brake hard and hold the brakes.
4) Increase speed.
column17:
当摩托车发生晃动或像蛇一样摆动（死亡摇摆/死亡晃动）时，你应该：
√ 1) 逐渐收油门并降低速度。
2) 放开车把，让摩托车自行稳定。
3) 猛踩刹车并按住。
4) 增加速度。
column19: 内胎 (Air chambers)：如果你骑的是带内胎的车，原则是换胎必换管 (Change tubes with tyres)。
column20: 蓄电池：加水只能加蒸馏水 (Distilled water)。

column16: 制动配比：希腊考试标准是 前 75% / 后 25%。记住前刹车是摩托车最主要的停止力。
column17: 死亡摇摆 (Wobble)：遇到车头剧烈晃动，绝不能急刹车或放手，必须逐渐收油 (Close progressively)。

column16: 盲区位置：摩托车手要主动避开汽车后视镜的盲区，确保能被前车在镜子里看到。
column17: 下坡档位：这是常考点，原则是“上坡用几档，下坡就用几档”，利用发动机制动。

column16: 车队骑行：最有经验或最快的骑手通常在最后，负责确保没有人掉队并处理后方情况。
column17: 起步/转弯最后动作：永远是 Shoulder check (回头看)。
